customManagers.description: The Postgres image scripts/db.sh runs locally, pinned by digest like the CI service image

packageRules.description: Dependency updates are chores, so they wait for the next feat or fix release instead of each cutting one. config:recommended would title production dependencies fix(deps). Later rules make a few of them fixes
A new distroless digest is how a fixed CVE in Node or Debian reaches the image, so it releases
Group the opentelemetry-js and opentelemetry-js-contrib monorepos. Their instrumentations pin the same exact 0.x @opentelemetry/instrumentation
Group Hono with its middleware and server packages, which declare peer ranges on it
Group Vite with its plugins, which declare peer ranges on it, and Rolldown, which the server build uses directly
Group Oxlint with its ESLint-rules plugin, which releases with it, and tsgolint, whose minimum version Oxlint sets
Add the React types to group:monorepos' React group
Group the Drizzle packages, which move their APIs together

Browser tests run in Playwright's image, whose browsers must match the playwright package. Strict filtering holds the whole group until the npm packages pass their release age, so the image can't ship alone. After the GitHub Actions group, so this group wins
Apply strict filtering to the npm side of the playwright group too, so the image can't ship alone
One Postgres image in scripts/db.sh and the CI service, so local and CI tests run the same server. After the GitHub Actions group, so this group wins
Leave engines.node alone while the new Node.js version still satisfies it. The global bump strategy would raise it to every new patch
Group Node.js and its types across mise.toml, the Dockerfile, and package.json

prBodyNotes: Rename `gcr.io/distroless/nodejs<major>-debian13` in the `Dockerfile` to the new major and pin its digest before merging. Renovate can't change the name.

packageRules.description: Keep pnpm on one version in mise.toml and the Dockerfile
Never automerge these, even minor and patch updates: the ORM and driver change the SQL airway runs, the MCP SDK changes what agents see, and ECharts changes every chart
